sandbachFocus: Sandbach United face a busy week with two fixtures. First, they travel to New Mills on Saturday 14 November for The Edward Case Cup (a cup competition), before hosting Shawbury United in the league on Saturday 21 November at 15:00. Currently top of the First Division South with 34 points from 16 games, Sandbach arrive in excellent form, having won their most recent league match and winning three of their last six league outings.
divisionWide: Saturday 14 November sees a full card of First Division South fixtures alongside Sandbach's cup tie. In the league, second-placed Wolverhampton Casuals (also on 34 points but with a game in hand) will be eyeing the title race, while third-placed Eccleshall face Bilston Town. Allscott Heath host Dawley Town, Foley Meir travel to Market Drayton Town, and Telford Town face Cheadle Heath Nomads. Wednesfield Community entertain Widnes Town—the division's bottom side on 7 points. On Tuesday 17 November, New Mills host Crewe and Shawbury United visit AFC Bridgnorth in midweek fixtures. The following Saturday (21 November) brings another round: AFC Bridgnorth (fourth, 30 points) host Wednesfield Community, Alsager Town travel to New Mills, Crewe face Cheadle Heath Nomads, Dawley Town host Foley Meir, Market Drayton Town entertain Stafford Town (fifth, 29 points), and Widnes Town visit Brereton Social. These fixtures see several mid-table and struggling sides jostling for position and points.
